text.tspan: What is the inconsistency in these parts of a
scientiﬁc paper?
A) The ﬁgure illustrates the reward function
diﬀerently than the deﬁnition in the text.
B) The text mentions that the reward function's
coeﬃcient is set to 1 based on LLM benchmarks,
but the ﬁgure shows a coeﬃcient of 10.
C) The text states the coeﬃcient of the reward
function is set to 10, but the ﬁgure shows the
head count set to 10 instead and does not contain
any information about the reward function.
D) The ﬁgure depicts scissors, but it is not
apparent from the caption or text what they
represent.
